rules.detail: ^error KRISHIV_UNSUPPORTED_FEATURE: The feature the Spark setting "spark\.sql\.legacy\.

summary: the file or statement sets a spark.sql.legacy.* setting to a non-default value Krishiv does not implement; SET is refused with KRISHIV_UNSUPPORTED_FEATURE, never run with the setting ignored (P3-T090, crates/krishiv-common/src/config/legacy.rs); the file's later statements, which depend on the refused SET, follow it
